places.name: Rumailah Farm
places.description: The UAE's first Jersey cow dairy farm, with a herd of several hundred cows. Guided tours show the cows, milking and production, finish with an ice cream tasting, and can be followed by breakfast at the farm. Book a tour in advance.

places.name: Wadi Al Helo
places.description: A green mountain valley in the Hajar Mountains on the road to Kalba, with farms, a small heritage village and fort, and Bronze Age copper-mining and rock-art sites. Good for a scenic drive, short walks and photography in the cooler months.
